lookalike.similarityRationale: Separate red lighter has similar dimensions and metal head but different body color; this is not an identical or same-color substitute.

deviations: Target moved right toward the red lighter, away from the tape, contrary to the directional instruction. Frozen source eligibility checks displacement magnitude, not direction; no criterion changed.
Target orientation also changed slightly. Full original frames and manual axis-aligned boxes are retained; no correction or synthesized image is used.
limitations: Manual image-plane boxes have boundary uncertainty; no externally instrumented position or semantic identity proof.
At approximately1Hz, motion under the opaque cover is not observable. User confirmation supports continuity but cannot rule out an invisible identical substitution.
